description: This file defines a singleton factory class 'DefaultHiveMqtt3ClientFactory' for creating MQTT v3 asynchronous clients using the HiveMQ client library. It provides methods to instantiate new clients or client builders, configuring them with connection parameters, optional listeners, and authentication details.

classes.name: DefaultHiveMqtt3ClientFactory
classes.description: A singleton factory class for creating and configuring HiveMQ MQTT v3 async clients, extending 'AbstractHiveMqttClientFactory' and implementing 'HiveMqtt3ClientFactory'.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the factory.

methods.name: newClient
methods.description: Creates a new MQTT v3 asynchronous client with specified connection parameters, optional listeners, and a connection logger.

methods.name: newClientBuilder
methods.description: Configures and returns a new MQTT v3 client builder with specified parameters, including authentication setup.
